title: ononis repens subsp. australis
intro: Ononis repens subsp. australis, commonly known as Australian burn plant, is a perennial plant species in the family Fabaceae. It has been used for its medicinal properties, including the treatment of various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations. The plant is believed to have health benefits due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe and calm irritated skin. The bioactive constituents of Ononis repens subsp. australis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
